threads.body: The request is created before the stable-semconv branch, so these unconditional aggregations also run on the legacy/default path. Each receive now performs several full batch scans plus `ArrayList`/`HashSet` allocations even though the default getter ignores these values, contradicting the PR's stated “Default-path impact: None.” Please gate or lazily compute the stable-only aggregates.

replies.body: Fixed in 858f7a8b986. Batch attributes are now initialized lazily on the first stable-path getter access, so constructing the request before `shouldStart` performs no message scans or aggregate allocations. Added a regression test that verifies request creation does not inspect the request or messages.

Consequently, default-mode batches now scan all messages three times (and read tags even when experimental attributes are disabled), despite the PR's stated “Default-path impact: None.” Please gate or lazily compute these batch aggregates so the legacy path remains unchanged.
